h1: Garage Conversions | Ely Newmarket Bury St Edmunds Cambridge

intro.html: An unused garage is one of the most overlooked opportunities in any home. At Gary J Potter Carpentry & Construction, we specialise in garage conversions that transform wasted space into rooms you’ll love to use every day. Working across Ely, Newmarket, Bury St Edmunds, Cambridge and surrounding areas across Cambridgeshire and Suffolk, we help homeowners unlock the hidden potential in their properties.

With over 40 years of combined bespoke carpenter and construction experience, we have the skills and expertise to deliver garage conversions that are practical, stylish and built to last. Whether you need a home office, gym, playroom or guest bedroom, our team will design and build a conversion that fits your lifestyle perfectly.

blocks.html: Moving house isn’t always the answer when you need more space. Garage conversions are a cost-effective way to gain an extra room without extending your property. By working with the existing structure, conversions can often be completed faster than full extensions while still adding significant value to your home.

We provide a comprehensive, design-to-completion service. From the initial consultation and layout planning through to plastering, flooring and finishing, every stage of your garage conversion is managed by us. With access to trusted groundworkers, plasterers and other trades, we coordinate everything in-house to ensure a smooth process and a high-quality result.

chapters.heading: Local Carpenter & Joinery Expertise in Garage Conversions

blocks.html: As specialist local carpenters, we bring a level of craftsmanship that sets our garage conversions apart. We install stud walls, flooring, insulation and bespoke joinery to make your new room feel like a natural extension of your home. Many clients also choose to include fitted storage or bespoke media walls in their conversion, making the most of the space available.

From the first sketch to the final finish, we’re here to make the process as simple as possible. We’ll advise on planning requirements if necessary, support with design and drawings, and deliver every stage of the build with precision. Our family-run team takes pride in clear communication and reliable service, so you always know your project is in safe hands.
